map-intro.title: Your home base
map-intro.description: This dashboard is your home base: revenue, fans, inbox health, and quick entry to every area of Circe et Venus—your command center for day-to-day work.

map-divine.title: Divine Manager
map-divine.description: Use the sidebar: Divine Manager is voice + text control of your AI assistant—tasks, Mimic style, notifications, and tools without leaving the page.

map-content-wellbeing.title: Content & Well-being
map-content-wellbeing.description: Content is your schedule and posts. Well-being is a calmer check-in (Mimic snapshot, cosmic calendar)—pair with work, not replace it.

map-messages-social.title: Messages & Social
map-messages-social.description: Messages is your unified OnlyFans/Fansly inbox. Social covers cross-platform promotion and reputation signals outside the adult platforms.

map-content-library.title: Content workspace
map-content-library.description: One sidebar entry opens Schedule, your media Vault, and a full list of posts — plan, shelf, and table without switching tools.

map-ai-studio.title: AI Studio
map-ai-studio.description: AI Studio bundles Media & Vault plus the full tools library (captions, churn, competitor insights, gifts, and more). Pro tools use credits where marked.

map-circe.title: Circe: retention & shield
map-circe.description: Under Circe: Analytics (revenue and fans), Retention (churn hub and scheduled scans), Protection (leaks, DMCA, Aegis). Purple = stay, protect, analyze.

map-venus.title: Venus: growth
map-venus.description: Under Venus: Fans, Commenter + Fan Atlas (post replies + smart lists), Mentions. Gold = attract, reply in public, reputation.

map-community-guide.title: Community & Guide
map-community-guide.description: Community has tips and Circe daily habits. Guide is the long-form manual—bookmark it. Settings holds billing, integrations, and security.

stats.title: Stats on this page
stats.description: Cards summarize revenue, fans, and conversation activity. Connect OnlyFans or Fansly under Settings → Integrations so numbers stay real.

platforms.title: Connected platforms
platforms.description: See which accounts are linked. Use Manage or Settings to connect, refresh tokens, or disconnect.

widgets.title: Widgets & shortcuts
widgets.description: Alerts, mentions, and quick links push you into Messages, Protection, AI Studio, or Divine—use them as your daily triage list.

list.title: Conversation list
list.description: All OnlyFans and Fansly threads in one list. Pick a fan to load the thread; unread counts and platform badges help you prioritize.

thread.title: Chat thread
thread.description: Read and reply here. Creatix can show media via a secure proxy; if something will not load, open the official OnlyFans or Fansly app for full video or DRM-locked content.

divine-ai.title: Divine & AI in chat
divine-ai.description: Use Divine or suggestion panels where available to draft replies—everything is review-first unless you explicitly enable auto-send in AI Chatter.

refresh.title: Refresh & actions
refresh.description: Refresh pulls the latest messages from the platform. Use the thread menu for read/unread and platform-specific actions on OnlyFans.

mass.title: Mass messaging
mass.description: Open Mass message from the Messages area to target segments or lists for promos and announcements—keep compliance and platform rules in mind.

purpose.title: Mass DM composer
purpose.description: Compose one campaign to many fans at once. Segment by tags, lists, or spend where the UI allows—this is your broadcast lane, not 1:1 chat.

review.title: Review before send
review.description: Preview copy and audience. Platform APIs may throttle or require confirmation; follow OnlyFans/Fansly rules for promotional content.

list.title: Fans
list.description: Subscriber and fan rows synced from connected platforms. Search, sort, and open a fan for notes, tags, and deep links to Messages.

tiers.title: Spend tiers
tiers.description: Whales, VIPs, and regulars help you prioritize outreach. Align with Fan Atlas and Churn for the same fans across the product.

classify.title: Classification & lists
classify.description: Use fan classification or smart lists on the Commenter page (Fan Atlas) to keep your segments aligned with OnlyFans lists.

add.title: Manual fans
add.description: Add a fan manually when you need notes or tracking for someone not yet synced—useful for cross-platform context.

workspace.title: Content workspace
workspace.description: Schedule, Vault, and All posts live behind one calm control — switch lenses without losing context.

calendar.title: Schedule
calendar.description: Calendar view for draft, scheduled, and published drops — see the rhythm of your week.

vault.title: Vault
vault.description: Media, metadata for Divine Manager PPV and recommendations, and platform links — the shelf behind every post.

new.title: New post
new.description: Compose a drop when you are ready — attach media, set timing, match each platform’s rules.

composer.title: Composer
composer.description: Write your post, attach media, and pick timing. Match your platform’s rules for PPV, teasers, and locked content.

schedule.title: Schedule & publish
schedule.description: Choose publish now or a future slot. Return to Content to edit or move items on the calendar.

overview.title: Analytics
overview.description: Revenue, fans, and engagement over time from synced snapshots. Use it to compare periods and platforms after connections are healthy.

breakdown.title: Platform breakdown
breakdown.description: Split OnlyFans vs Fansly where both are connected. Pair with Retention for churn risk and with Income Predictor for forward-looking goals.

income-predictor-link.title: Income Predictor
income-predictor-link.description: Open Income Predictor from Analytics for forecast-style goals and cadence—Pro-only where billing applies.

forecast.title: Income Predictor
forecast.description: Blends partner statistics with your synced snapshots and goals. Use maintain vs grow modes and calendar notes to sanity-check next month.

goals.title: Goals & realism
goals.description: Set targets and read intermediate bands—this is planning, not a guarantee. Revisit after major campaigns or platform changes.

overview.title: Well-being hub
overview.description: One screen for inbox load, Mimic profile snapshot, Gift wishlist (product context for fans and AI), and a cosmic calendar—so you can breathe and plan without juggling five tabs.

mimic-snapshot.title: Mimic snapshot
mimic-snapshot.description: Warmth, humor, and flirt sliders from your Mimic profile. Finish the voice interview in Divine Manager when you want fan-facing drafts to sound like you.

cosmic-hero.title: Cosmic calendar
cosmic-hero.description: Moon phase, zodiac, and monthly grid—optional rhythm. Pair with Community → Circe daily tips for habit ideas.

rhythm.title: Rhythm, not rigor
rhythm.description: Use this as a gentle check-in, not a scorecard. Pair with Community when you want structured habit ideas.

welcome.title: Welcome to Divine Manager
welcome.description: Operations orbit: live voice, text chat, protocol tasks, Mimic, and today’s plan. First visit runs a short setup wizard (example phrases, goals, notifications); after that, tune goals under Preferences. Guide links and `?section=protocol`, `tasks`, or `chat` jump the page or open text chat—scroll if you landed mid-page.

voice.title: Voice with the crown
voice.description: Tap the floating crown to talk. Open the launcher for Text Divine and shortcuts, or jump straight into voice from settings.

text.title: Text chat
text.description: The text sheet runs the same manager brain—best for long prompts, links, or when you cannot speak.

protocol-rail.title: Protocol tasks
protocol-rail.description: The protocol card lists follow-ups and workflows (same queue as the crown menu). `?section=tasks` focuses this card; `?section=protocol` scrolls the whole Today plan + tasks block. Open the crown menu anytime for the same queue without leaving voice.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.description: Live vs Divine: platform activity vs leaks, billing, reputation, and Divine actions. Run a briefing to walk saved rows with Divine.

mimic.title: Mimic Test
mimic.description: Voice interview so Divine mirrors your fan-reply style. Drafts are review-first; a future Voice Cloning runner in AI Studio is planned for extra samples.

today-plan.title: Today plan and tasks
today-plan.description: When beta mode is on, suggested moves for the day sit above protocol tasks in one section (`#divine-section-protocol`). Open it from the Guide or `?section=protocol`; automation hooks and large-tip rules appear here when configured.

voice-settings.title: Voice settings
voice-settings.description: Brevity vs expressiveness, when End call unlocks, DM focus, composer timing, and optional instant crown start.

guide-link.title: Guide
guide-link.description: The Guide has a full Divine Manager chapter with deep links. Revisit anytime from the sidebar.

tabs.title: AI Studio
tabs.description: Two tabs: Media & Vault (assets, descriptions, safe edits) and Tools (full library). Credits apply where each tool says so; Pro gates apply for premium tools.

vault.title: Media & Vault
vault.description: Tag content for Divine, link OnlyFans posts, vault photos for PPV context, and run safe photo touch-ups.

tools.title: Tools library
tools.description: Captions, churn, competitor analysis, gifts, fantasy writer, and more. Some tools are listed as Coming soon until they are ready.

chatter-gifts.title: Chatter & gifts
chatter-gifts.description: Open AI Chatter and Gift wishlist from here for DM automation and product links in gift suggestions.

grid.title: Tools library
grid.description: Search and filter by category. Each card opens a runner or redirects to the right dashboard (e.g. Fan Atlas, Retention, Protection).

credits.title: Credits & Pro
credits.description: Credits show in the header. Pro-only tools require an active plan; locked cards link to billing.

open.title: Run a tool
open.description: Click through to run from the workspace. Outputs are yours to copy into messages, posts, or protocols.

purpose.title: AI Chatter
purpose.description: Per-fan DM automation for OnlyFans: drafts, queues, optional auto-send (beta). Pair with Mimic for tone and with Messages for the live thread.

profiles.title: Profiles & whales
profiles.description: Switch modes or whale whisper profiles where available. Review everything before send unless you have explicitly enabled automation.

wishlist.title: Gift wishlist
wishlist.description: Save HTTPS product links; we pull titles, prices, and details when possible so Chatter, Divine, and Gift Suggester know what to suggest when a fan sends a gift.

use.title: Using in tools
use.description: Build your list here, then run Gift Suggester from Divine Manager (or pin it on the home dashboard) when you want AI-ranked picks using this context.

tabs.title: Settings
tabs.description: Profile, Integrations, Security, Billing, and preferences. Integrations connect OnlyFans and Fansly; billing controls Pro and credits.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect OnlyFans via secure OAuth popup; Fansly via email/password in the dialog. Disconnect here if tokens expire.

billing.title: Billing & plan
billing.description: Upgrade, payment method, and usage limits where applicable. Adult-platform billing may gate certain features.

guide-hub.title: Guide & orbital tour
guide-hub.description: This page combines the full-app tour story with the manual: scroll animated steps (each callout sits above the surface it describes), launch the live tour from Welcome, or expand Deep reference for integrations and troubleshooting.

header-tour.title: Header: full live tour
header-tour.description: On any page, the header’s Start live tour / Launch live tour runs the same full live tour you can start from Welcome (with auto-start).

overview.title: Protection
overview.description: Leak alerts, DMCA drafts, and resolution history. Paste URLs to scan; review every claim before sending to third parties.

aegis.title: Aegis hub
aegis.description: Open Circe’s Aegis for scheduled scans, optional draft DMCAs, and links to broader protection settings—see the Protection tour on the Aegis page for detail.

shield.title: Aegis
shield.description: Unified hub: shield toggles, Sentinel schedule, leak-scan defaults, optional Hammer drafts, and links to Mentions for reputation (separate from leak alerts).

schedule.title: Scans & drafts
schedule.description: Configure cadence and severity. Review every automated draft before it is sent externally.

dmca.title: DMCA & leaks
dmca.description: Leak Scanner and DMCA Automator can draft from severe findings—you still review and send from Protection.

reputation.title: Social promotion
reputation.description: Cross-platform promotion and reputation signals. Connect accounts where available so scans have context.

mentions.title: With Mentions
mentions.description: Use Venus → Mentions for review queues; Social complements with broader promotion context.

queue.title: Mentions
queue.description: Inbound mentions and reputation items to triage. Mark reviewed when handled; escalate to Protection if leaks overlap.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Pair with Commenter for public replies and with Divine for suggested responses where enabled.

hub.title: Retention hub
hub.description: Churn Predictor: scheduled scans for expiring subs and quiet fans, using your synced fan data. Configure cadence, credits, and notifications here.

last-run.title: Last run & output
last-run.description: Last run shows when the background job completed. Keep Fans synced so expiries and spend are accurate; some media may only fully play in the official platform app.

protocols.title: Protocols & tasks
protocols.description: Open protocols and tasks to act on batches. Link to AI Studio churn tool for one-off deep dives on a fan.

tease.title: Future tease
tease.description: Optional calendar notes feed retention teasers in scans—align with Content calendar for consistent messaging.

feed.title: Commenter
feed.description: Sync post and story comments from OnlyFans via webhooks and API. Review each fan comment with AI safety and persona reply drafts.

personas.title: Circe, Venus, Flirt, Pro
personas.description: Pick a persona suggestion or Best pick—copy to OnlyFans manually; review-only by default. Stalking or risk flags surface for Divine notifications.

housekeeping.title: Fan Atlas
housekeeping.description: Smart classify: auto-segment fans by spend, thread/DM activity, cold fans, and freeloaders — then sync those segments to OnlyFans lists and Fansly tags. Configure under Fans → Arrangements or here.

tips.title: Community
tips.description: Approved tips and community content. Use it for peer ideas and habit inspiration—not official support.

circe-daily.title: Circe daily tips
circe-daily.description: Open Circe daily tips for numbered habits and anchors; link from Well-being when you want structured routines.

daily.title: Circe daily tips
daily.description: Numbered tips with anchors for deep linking. Use alongside Well-being and Community for habits.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.description: Toggle tip types in Settings → Preferences when available so the feed matches your focus.
